models.name: GPT-6（ChatGPT · Intelligent UI）
models.title: GPT-6 进 ChatGPT 聊天：回答会直接长出可点的界面（Intelligent UI）
models.titleEn: GPT-6 comes to ChatGPT chat: answers can arrive as interactive interfaces (Intelligent UI)
models.summary: OpenAI 2026-10-07 发布：GPT-6 进入 ChatGPT 的聊天页，免费用户也有。最大的变化叫 Intelligent UI：回答不再只是文字，模型会自己决定要不要配图表、按钮、表单、地图或可交互的示意图，比如拆解一辆 7 速自行车的结构可以点着看，也能当场做一个存钱计算器或分账小工具。官方说背后是一套能边生成边显示的原生组件库加一个编译器，并专门训练了模型做版式和交互的取舍，什么时候纯文字就够也算在内。付费档（Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise）用 GPT-6 Sol，免费和 Go 档用 GPT-6 Luna；10-07 起付费档上线，次日扩到免费档。官方还说 GPT-6 能边想边答，联网问题的 Instant 版平均早 44% 开始出字。Work 和 Codex 里的模型这次不变。
models.summaryEn: OpenAI, 2026-10-07: GPT-6 comes to ChatGPT's chat tab, free users included. The headline change is Intelligent UI: instead of text only, the model decides whether to add charts, buttons, forms, maps, or interactive diagrams, so a breakdown of a 7-speed bike becomes something you tap through, and it can build a savings calculator or bill splitter on the spot. OpenAI says this runs on a library of native, streamable components plus a compiler, and that the model was trained to make layout and interaction choices, including when plain text is enough. Paid tiers (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise) get GPT-6 Sol; Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna. Paid rollout starts 10-07 and expands to Free the next day. OpenAI also says GPT-6 can start answering while it keeps thinking, with Instant starting 44% sooner on average for web-search questions. Models in Work and Codex are unchanged.

sources.label: OpenAI：GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
sources.labelEn: OpenAI: GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone

highlights.text: Intelligent UI 是什么：回答里可以有图、可点的按钮、表单、图表和能操作的小工具。比较类问题可能并排放，原理类可能给一张能拖动参数的示意图，简单问题仍然只回一段字。这对做设计的人值得看：聊天界面开始由模型自己排版。
highlights.textEn: What Intelligent UI is: answers can contain graphics, tappable buttons, forms, charts, and small working tools. A comparison may sit side by side, an explanation may become a diagram you can adjust, and a simple question still gets a paragraph. Worth a look for designers: the chat interface is now laid out by the model itself.

highlights.text: 官方说的做法：做了一套能流式显示的原生组件库，再加一个编译器，让界面边生成边出现；训练时专门评估模型做出的界面清不清楚、有没有用、完不完整。官方也承认模型的设计判断还要继续改进。
highlights.textEn: How OpenAI says it works: a library of native, streamable components plus a compiler so the interface appears while it is generated; training evaluated the interfaces for clarity, usefulness, and completeness. OpenAI also says the model's design judgment still needs work.

highlights.text: 谁用哪个：Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 用 GPT-6 Sol，Free 和 Go 用 GPT-6 Luna，两者都针对日常对话调过。只改聊天页，Work 和 Codex 不变。企业版是否可用看管理员设置。
highlights.textEn: Who gets what: Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise get GPT-6 Sol; Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna, both tuned for everyday conversation. Chat only; Work and Codex are unchanged. Enterprise depends on admin settings.

highlights.text: 官方自测，本库未复跑：联网问题上 GPT-6 Instant 平均比 GPT-5.6 Instant 早 44% 开始回答；内部日常任务评测里，GPT-6 Extra High 开始回答的时间和 GPT-5.6 Medium 差不多，总分高于 GPT-5.6 Extra High。
highlights.textEn: Vendor tests, not re-run here: for web-search questions GPT-6 Instant starts answering 44% sooner on average than GPT-5.6 Instant; in an internal everyday-task eval, GPT-6 Extra High starts answering about as fast as GPT-5.6 Medium while scoring above GPT-5.6 Extra High.

models.title: Claude Haiku 5.5：Anthropic 最便宜、最快的小模型，价格约降四分之三
models.titleEn: Claude Haiku 5.5: Anthropic's cheapest, fastest small model, about 75% cheaper to run
models.summary: Anthropic 2026-10-07 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，定位是量大、怕贵、要快的活：摘要、分类、数据库查询、在线客服、操作浏览器，或者给 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 当写代码时的小帮手。官方说平均跑起来比 Haiku 4.5 便宜约 75%。价格按每百万 token 算，提示词在 10 万 token 以内时输入 0.10 美元、输出 0.50 美元，超过 10 万时是 0.50 和 2.50。这是第一款能调「思考力度」的 Haiku。同一天 Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取降价一半，Max 和 Team 订阅也开始送每月 API 额度。平台模型名 claude-haiku-5-5，各大云平台都能用。
models.summaryEn: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 on 2026-10-07 for high-volume, cost- and speed-sensitive work: summaries, classification, database queries, live customer support, browser use, or helping Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 as a coding subagent. Anthropic says it costs about 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 on average. Per million tokens, prompts up to 100K are $0.10 input and $0.50 output; over 100K, $0.50 and $2.50. It is the first Haiku with an adjustable effort setting. The same day, Sonnet 5.5 cache reads were halved and Max and Team subscriptions got a monthly API credit. Platform model id claude-haiku-5-5, available on the major clouds.

highlights.text: 适合干什么：大量的短活，比如摘要、压缩上下文、查库、分类、在线客服、操作浏览器；或者大模型做主力、它当子代理去查资料。官方自己也写：复杂的代码任务还是 Sonnet 5.5、Opus 5.5 更合适。
highlights.textEn: What it's for: lots of short jobs such as summaries, context compaction, database queries, classification, live support, and browser use, or serving as a subagent that fetches facts for a bigger model. Anthropic itself says Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 remain better for complex coding.

highlights.text: 价格（每百万 token，提示词 ≤10 万 / >10 万）：输入 0.10 / 0.50 美元，输出 0.50 / 2.50 美元，缓存读取 0.01 / 0.05 美元，缓存写入 0.125 / 0.625 美元。对照 Haiku 4.5：输入 1 美元、输出 5 美元。官方说以前 Haiku 约九成请求在 10 万 token 以内。
highlights.textEn: Pricing (per million tokens, prompts ≤100K / >100K): input $0.10 / $0.50, output $0.50 / $2.50, cache reads $0.01 / $0.05, cache writes $0.125 / $0.625. For comparison, Haiku 4.5 is $1 input and $5 output. Anthropic says about 90% of previous Haiku requests were under 100K tokens.

highlights.text: 官方表节选，本库未复跑（列 Haiku 5.5 / Haiku 4.5 / GPT-6 Luna / Sonnet 5.5）：OSWorld 2.1 离线子集 72.4% / 15.7% / 48.9% / 83.9%；Terminal-Bench 4.0 39.2% / 0.0% / 16.4% / 70.6%；GDPval-AA v2.1 1620 / 735 / 1437 / 1840。

models.name: Strands Decider 2B
models.title: Strands Decider 2B：一个小的开源决策模型，只做选择题和打分
models.titleEn: Strands Decider 2B: a small open decision model that picks an option or gives a score
models.summary: Strands Decider 2B 是 Strands Agents 放出的一个小决策模型。它不写文章。你给它一段现状和几个允许的答案，它为每个答案打一个概率，也可以按一个分数尺打分。仓库写它大约 19 亿参数，基于 Qwen3.5-2B 改来，拿掉了原来用来生成文字的那一层，换上一个大约一百万参数的小头。代码和权重以 Apache-2.0 发布，可以在自己的 CPU 或显卡上跑。官博是 2026-10-01，仓库现在指向的参考版本是 v21，更早的 v19 仍在。本库没有安装，也没有复跑仓库里的分数。
models.summaryEn: Strands Decider 2B is a small decision model from Strands Agents. It does not write prose. You give it a situation and the answers you allow, and it returns a probability for each one, or a score on a scale. The repo says it has about 1.9 billion parameters, starts from Qwen3.5-2B, removes the layer that used to generate text, and adds a small head of about a million parameters. Code and weights are Apache-2.0, and it can run on your own CPU or GPU. The blog is dated 2026-10-01. The repo’s reference version now is v21, and the earlier v19 is still published. This library did not install it and did not re-run the repo’s scores.

sources.label: Strands 官博：Introducing Strands Decider 2B
sources.by: Marc Brooker, Mike Chambers, Fabio Nonato de Paula

sources.label: Hugging Face：当前参考权重 v21
sources.labelEn: Hugging Face: current reference weights, v21

highlights.text: 它是决策模型：不自由写字。你给现状，再给允许的答案。问题有三种，仓库用 noul（是或否）、choice（多选一）和 score（按分数尺打分）。一次前向就把这些答案的概率算出来。仓库写参数量约 19 亿，躯干是 Qwen3.5-2B-Base，原来的语言模型头被拿掉，换成约一百万参数的指针头，再用 rank-16 的 LoRA 微调。LoRA 是只训练一小部分新增权重的做法。
highlights.textEn: It is a decision model: it does not write free text. You provide a situation and the answers you allow. The repo’s three question types are noul (yes or no), choice (one of several), and score (a point on a scale). One forward pass produces the probabilities. The repo says about 1.9 billion parameters. The torso is Qwen3.5-2B-Base, the old language-model head is removed, a pointer head of about a million parameters replaces it, and a rank-16 LoRA adapts the torso. LoRA means only a small set of added weights is trained.

highlights.text: 怎么试（仓库写的命令，本库没跑过）：pip install strands-decider，然后 strands-decider ask，模型名写 StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21。也可以在本机 serve。仓库写它能在 CPU、苹果芯片 Mac 或一块消费级显卡上跑。许可 Apache-2.0。
highlights.textEn: How to try, as the repo writes it (not run here): pip install strands-decider, then strands-decider ask with the model id StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21. You can also serve it locally. The repo says it runs on CPU, an Apple-silicon Mac, or a consumer GPU. License Apache-2.0.

highlights.text: 仓库自测，本库未复跑，也不把它当成排名。README 的表：JevBench 公开集 231 题，v21 准确率 0.762（176/231），v19 为 0.723（167/231）。同一张表写，六次种子的平均和 v19 配方几乎一样，单次相差大约 10 题以内就算没有分出胜负。延迟列在 v19：RTX 3090 中位 115 ms。官博 10 月 1 日还有一套“在 2B 档第几名”的说法，本卡不转述，因为仓库后来的表自己提醒小差距不可靠。
highlights.textEn: Repo self-test, not re-run here, and not treated as a ranking. The README table: on the 231-task public JevBench set, v21 accuracy is 0.762 (176/231) and v19 is 0.723 (167/231). The same table says a six-seed average of the v21 recipe and the v19 recipe land in the same place, and a gap under about 10 tasks between two single runs is unresolved. The latency column is on v19: median 115 ms on an RTX 3090. The October 1 blog also has a “place in the 2B class” claim. This card does not repeat it, because the repo’s later table says small gaps are not reliable.

models.name: EmbeddingGemma 2
models.title: EmbeddingGemma 2：把文字、图片、声音和视频收成同一套向量的小模型
models.titleEn: EmbeddingGemma 2: a small model that turns text, images, audio, and video into one vector space
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 是 Google DeepMind 在 2026-10-06 发布的开源嵌入模型。嵌入是一串数字，用来表示一段文字、一张图或一段声音的意思，方便按意思搜索，而不是按关键词硬对。这一版把文字（含代码）、图片、视频和声音放进同一个 768 维的空间。模型卡写总参数 7.4 亿，其中文字部分约 2.7 亿，视觉编码器 1.7 亿，音频编码器 3 亿，可以只加载用得到的那一部分。许可页标题是 Apache License 2.0。它面向手机和笔记本上的本地搜索。模型卡里的测试分是 Google 自己报的，本库没有复跑，也没有下载权重。
models.summaryEn: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open embedding model Google DeepMind released on 2026-10-06. An embedding is a list of numbers that stands for the meaning of a passage, a picture, or a sound, so you can search by meaning rather than by exact keywords. This version puts text (including code), images, video, and audio in one 768-dimension space. The model card says 740 million parameters in total: about 270 million for text, a 170 million vision encoder, and a 300 million audio encoder, and you can load only the part you need. The license page is titled Apache License 2.0. It is aimed at search on a phone or laptop. Scores on the model card are Google’s own. This library did not re-run them and did not download the weights.

sources.label: Google 官博：EmbeddingGemma 2
sources.by: Sahil Dua, Henrique Schechter Vera, Google DeepMind

highlights.text: 模型卡写：总参数 7.4 亿。文字骨干 1.3 亿加嵌入层 1.4 亿，合起来约 2.7 亿；视觉编码器 1.7 亿，音频编码器 3 亿。输出默认 768 维，也可以截成 512、256 或 128 维，用来少占存储。上下文窗口 8192 token。输入可以是文字、图片、视频、声音，以及它们的组合。
highlights.textEn: The model card says 740 million parameters total. The text side is a 130 million backbone plus a 140 million embedder, about 270 million together. The vision encoder is 170 million and the audio encoder is 300 million. The default output is 768 dimensions, and it can be cut to 512, 256, or 128 to store less. The context window is 8,192 tokens. Inputs can be text, images, video, audio, and combinations of those.

highlights.text: 模型卡上的对比分（官方数字，本库未复跑）：代码检索 MTEB Code 的 NDCG@10，EmbeddingGemma 2 是 78.68，上一版是 68.76。多语言文本 MTEB 的平均分是 61.36，上一版是 61.15。模型卡正文另写代码任务相对上一版大约提高 14%。这两处是同一张表和同一页的说法。
highlights.textEn: Comparison scores on the model card (vendor numbers, not re-run here): on MTEB Code, NDCG@10 is 78.68 for EmbeddingGemma 2 and 68.76 for the previous version. Multilingual text MTEB mean is 61.36 versus 61.15. The card’s prose also says code tasks improved by about 14% versus the previous version. Those are the table and the prose on the same page.

highlights.text: 怎么拿（官方渠道，本库没下载）：权重在 Hugging Face 的 google/embeddinggemma-2。文档在 ai.google.dev 的 EmbeddingGemma 页。模型卡写可以用 transformers、sentence-transformers 等常见库加载，也面向设备端。官博还写了在手机上的内存占用和能塞进多少分钟音频，那些设备数字没有写进模型卡的规格表，本卡不另抄一份。
highlights.textEn: Where to get it (official channels, not downloaded here): weights are at google/embeddinggemma-2 on Hugging Face. Docs are the EmbeddingGemma page on ai.google.dev. The model card says it loads with common libraries such as transformers and sentence-transformers, and that it is meant for devices. The blog also states phone memory and how many minutes of audio fit. Those device figures are not in the model card’s spec table, so this card does not copy a second set.

models.summary: Nano Banana 2.1 是 Google 在 2026 年 10 月 6 日（北京时间 10 月 7 日凌晨）发布的出图和改图模型，是 Nano Banana 2 的升级版。适合要做海报、信息图、商品图、角色设定，并且需要反复修改的设计师和内容创作者。Google 在 X 上说它全面超过自家之前的图片模型，进步最明显的是三件事：版式设计、用遮罩改图（先圈出一块区域，只改这一块），以及同一个人物或商品在多张图里保持一致。普通用户可以在 Gemini App 里试（官方模型卡把它列为发布渠道，正在陆续上线）；开发者可以在 Google AI Studio 里试，或用 API 调用 gemini-nano-banana-2.1，API 没有免费档。下面的对比分数和价格都是 Google 自己公布的，本库没有实际出图、没有复跑对比。
models.summaryEn: Nano Banana 2.1 is Google’s image generation and editing model, released on 6 October 2026 (early 7 October Beijing time) as an upgrade to Nano Banana 2. It suits designers and content creators who make posters, infographics, product shots, or character sheets and need to iterate. Google’s X post says it beats the company’s previous image models across the board, with the biggest gains in visual design, mask-based editing (outline an area and change only that part), and keeping the same person or product consistent across images. Regular users can try it in the Gemini app (listed as a launch channel on the model card, rolling out); developers can try it in Google AI Studio or call gemini-nano-banana-2.1 through the API, which has no free tier. The comparison scores and prices below are Google’s own; this library did not generate images or re-run any comparison.

highlights.text: 官方称（X 帖与模型卡）：这一版主要强在三处。一是版式设计，海报、信息图这种要把大字标题、照片和小标签排在一起的图更像样；二是遮罩或涂鸦改图，圈出一块或在图上画几笔，只改那一块；三是主体一致，同一个人物或商品放进多张图里还是同一个样子。宣传短片里能看到一张户外越野跑海报（大字标题、圆形照片、坐标和标签排版）、一只挂着水珠的甲虫特写和一组干花微距。这些是 Google 自己挑的样片，不代表每次出图都这样。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim (X post and model card): the release focuses on three things. Visual design: posters and infographics that mix big headlines, photos, and small labels come out better. Mask or doodle editing: outline an area or scribble on it, and only that part changes. Subject consistency: the same person or product looks the same across images. The promo clip shows a trail-running poster (bold headline, circular photo, coordinates and label layout), a dew-covered beetle close-up, and dried-flower macros. These are samples Google picked; they do not mean every result looks like this.

highlights.text: 官方开发者文档写的具体变化：出图分 1K、2K、4K 三档，默认 1K；修好了超宽、超长比例（1:4、4:1、1:8、8:1）在 2K 和 4K 下出现的拼接痕迹；图里的文字和信息图排版更准；一次最多放 14 张参考图，其中最多 4 个角色保持长相一致、最多 10 个物品保持外观；可以先用 Google 网页和图片搜索查资料再画；「思考」程度可选 minimal、medium（默认）、high，也就是让模型先想多少再动笔。输入可以是文字、图片、视频和 PDF。
highlights.textEn: Specific changes in the developer docs: output at 1K, 2K, or 4K (1K by default); fixed seam artifacts on very wide or tall ratios (1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1) at 2K and 4K; more accurate text and infographic layout; up to 14 reference images in one request, keeping up to 4 characters and up to 10 objects consistent; can look things up with Google Web and Image Search before drawing; a Thinking setting of minimal, medium (default), or high, i.e. how much the model plans before drawing. Inputs can be text, images, video, and PDF.

highlights.text: 官方模型卡的对比分（找人两两比较哪张更好，再算出相对分，越高越好，只在这张表里互相比较有意义；本库未复跑）：开「思考」时，总体偏好 1050，Nano Banana 2 是 990，Nano Banana Pro 是 935；信息图设计 1048，对比 961 和 912；遮罩或涂鸦改图 1049，对比 965 和 927；多角色一致 1106，对比 978 和 1011。不开「思考」时分数低一些，例如总体偏好 1015。
highlights.textEn: Model-card comparison scores (people pick the better image in pairs, then a relative score is computed; higher is better and it only means something within this table; not re-run here). With Thinking on: overall preference 1050 vs 990 for Nano Banana 2 and 935 for Nano Banana Pro; infographic design 1048 vs 961 and 912; mask or doodle editing 1049 vs 965 and 927; multi-character consistency 1106 vs 978 and 1011. Scores are lower with Thinking off, e.g. 1015 for overall preference.

highlights.text: 怎么试（官方渠道）：模型卡列出的上线渠道有 Gemini App、Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Google 搜索的 AI 模式、Google Ads、Google Flow 和 Google Stitch。设计师最直接的是 Gemini App 和 Flow；要接进自己工具的，在 AI Studio 先试再看出图指南调 API。官方价格页（撰写时）：API 只有付费档，按张折算 1K 约 0.0336 美元、2K 约 0.0504 美元、4K 约 0.113 美元，批量模式约半价。有些第三方文章把 4K 写成 0.0756 美元，与官方价格页不符，以官方为准。
highlights.textEn: How to try (official channels): the model card lists the Gemini app, Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, AI Mode in Google Search, Google Ads, Google Flow, and Google Stitch. For designers the Gemini app and Flow are the most direct; to wire it into your own tools, try it in AI Studio first, then follow the image generation guide. Official pricing at write time: the API is paid only, roughly $0.0336 per 1K image, $0.0504 per 2K, and $0.113 per 4K, with Batch about half. Some third-party articles list 4K at $0.0756, which does not match the official pricing page; go by the official page.

highlights.text: 边界（官方模型卡自己写的不足）：小字容易糊，1K 档尤其明显，长段落、整页文字也不行；输入图和输出图里的人物不一定完全一致；遮罩或涂鸦改图有时只听了一半，涂鸦痕迹可能留在图上；改图时偶尔沿用原图的姿势；有时分不清左右；3D 空间和事实准确性仍有限。要印刷级清晰小字的物料，别直接用 1K 出图交付。旧版 gemini-3.1-flash-image 已在 API 上标为弃用，官方更新日志撰写时写「还没定关停日期」。
highlights.textEn: Limits (from the model card itself): small text often blurs, especially at 1K, and long paragraphs or full pages do not work well; people in the input and output images are not always consistent; masked or doodle edits sometimes follow only part of the instruction, and scribbles can remain; edits occasionally keep the original pose; left and right sometimes get mixed up; 3D reasoning and factual accuracy are still limited. For print work that needs crisp small text, do not ship 1K output as is. The older gemini-3.1-flash-image is marked deprecated on the API; at write time the release notes say no shutdown date has been announced.

models.summaryEn: Beam is Reflection’s open-weight model, announced on 5 October 2026, for people who write code, reason through problems, or hand work to a coding agent. It is a sparse mixture-of-experts model: 501 billion parameters in total, with 23 billion active on each step. It is not downloadable yet. The site says it is still in final safety testing (checking whether it can be talked into doing something it should not), and that early access is a signup only. Weights, the technical report, the model card, and the developer extras are promised later this month, under Apache 2.0. The scores on the page are the vendor’s own numbers and were not re-run here.

highlights.text: 官方称：预训练用了 23.8 万亿 token（文本切成的小段），在 6144 张 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 上不到四周跑完。强化学习用 1.05 万张 NVIDIA GB300，四周里产生超过 1 亿次尝试，单次上下文最长 256K token；文中写中期训练把可用上下文拉到 100 万 token。这些都是厂商自述，本库没有复现训练。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: pretraining used 23.8 trillion tokens and finished in under four weeks on 6,144 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 GPUs. Reinforcement learning used 10,500 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs, produced more than 100 million rollouts over four weeks, and allowed up to 256K tokens of context; the post says midtraining extends usable context to 1 million tokens. All of that is the vendor’s account. This library did not reproduce the training.

models.summary: kouhxp 开源的 gutsy-0.8b（v0.4）：把 Qwen3.5-0.8B 微调成决策模型，不生成自由文本。你送一段状态（文本或 JSON）和 typed questions（yes/no、choice、score），它为每个选项返回校准概率；choice / score 还带 reject。运行时 gutsy-inference 走 llama.cpp，默认可在普通 CPU 上起本地 HTTP；接口刻意对齐 Jev / System One（`/v1/systemone` 等），现有客户端多半只换 base URL。权重在 Hugging Face kouhxp/gutsy（Q8_0 与 Q4_K_M GGUF），代码与权重 README 写 Apache-2.0。JevBench / 评测表与延迟是作者自测，本库未复跑。同板与 Jev、Laya、Clef、Jeeves、Ollaya 相邻；Cases 已有本机 Jeff 与 Onesie CLI。
models.summaryEn: kouhxp’s open gutsy-0.8b (v0.4) fine-tunes Qwen3.5-0.8B into a decision model that does not generate free text. You send a state (text or JSON) plus typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) and get a calibrated probability for every option; choice / score answers also carry reject. The gutsy-inference runtime uses llama.cpp and can serve a local HTTP API on an ordinary CPU. The API deliberately matches Jev / System One (`/v1/systemone` and related), so many existing clients only need a new base URL. Weights live on Hugging Face kouhxp/gutsy (Q8_0 and Q4_K_M GGUF); README says Apache-2.0 for code and weights. JevBench / eval tables and latency are author self-tests, not re-run here. On this board it sits next to Jev, Laya, Clef, Jeeves, and Ollaya; Cases already lists local Jeff and the Onesie CLI.

models.summaryEn: Cloudflare released the open-weight decision model Clef and the smaller Clef-Flash. They do not generate free text: they read a state plus typed questions and return a probability for every allowed answer. On Workers AI the ids are @cf/cloudflare/clef (27B) and @cf/cloudflare/clef-flash (9B). The vendor says the API matches Jev / System One, with noul / choice / score questions and a vision encoder, so state can be text, JSON, images, or video. Weights are on Hugging Face under Apache-2.0. The HF cards say Clef is post-trained from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B and Clef-Flash from Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B — a vendor / HF claim. The blog also announces RL fine-tuning: hands-on with a forward-deployed engineer first, then a later self-serve platform. That is a roadmap, not a product depth this library verified. Decision Index, latency, and workflow scores are vendor claims and were not re-run here. On this board it sits next to Jev, Laya, Jeeves, and Ollaya; Cases already lists local Jeff and the Onesie CLI.

models.summary: Anthropic 于 2026-09-22 发布的 Claude 5.5 家族第一款模型（官方页标题 “Introducing Claude Opus 5.5”，HTTP 200）。官方页正文称：它在多数工作上达到 Claude Fable 5.1 的水平，按典型负载跑起来比 Opus 5 少 40% 花费；meta description 称它在 agentic coding 与知识工作上领先，且比 Opus 5 少 40% 运行成本。官方价目（每百万 token）：输入 $4、输出 $20（称比 Opus 5 少 20%），cache reads $0.20（对照 Opus 5 的 $0.50，称少 60%），cache writes $5（对照 $6.25）；fast mode 为输入 $8 / 输出 $40，称最高 2.5 倍速度。第三方榜：Artificial Analysis 页面（变体 “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”）列出 Intelligence Index 58（#1 / 211）、输入 $4.00 / 输出 $20.00、缓存折扣 95%、每任务 $5.98、1M 上下文；速度栏为 N/A。HN：item 49803892（Algolia 核对 1793pts，2026-09-22 ~16:29Z）。
models.summaryEn: Anthropic’s first model in the Claude 5.5 family, announced 2026-09-22 (official page title “Introducing Claude Opus 5.5”, HTTP 200). The page says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads; the meta description says it leads in agentic coding and knowledge work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5. Vendor price table (per 1M tokens): input $4, output $20 (claimed 20% less than Opus 5), cache reads $0.20 (vs Opus 5 at $0.50, claimed 60% less), cache writes $5 (vs $6.25); fast mode is $8 input / $40 output, claimed up to 2.5× speed. Third-party board: the Artificial Analysis page (variant “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”) lists Intelligence Index 58 (#1 / 211), $4.00 input / $20.00 output, a 95% cache discount, $5.98 per task, and a 1M context; the speed cell is N/A. HN: item 49803892 (1793pts on Algolia at check time, 2026-09-22 ~16:29Z).

The same page says Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 follow in the coming weeks. The platform model id is written claude-opus-5-5, and the page says it is available on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

highlights.text: 官方称（价目表，每百万 token）：cache reads $0.20（Opus 5 为 $0.50）、输入 $4（Opus 5 为 $5）、输出 $20（Opus 5 为 $25）、cache writes $5（Opus 5 为 $6.25）。页面另写输入/输出比 Opus 5 少 20%，cache reads 少 60%；fast mode（Claude Code 与 Claude Platform）最高 2.5 倍速度，输入 $8 / 输出 $40。本库未实测 API。

API not tested here.

highlights.text: 官方称（对照表，列序 Opus 5.5 / Fable 5.1 / Opus 5 / GPT-6 Astra / GPT-5.6 Sol；页注除另有说明外 Opus 5.5 为 adaptive thinking、max effort；Terminal-Bench 4.0 的 Opus 5.5 为 xhigh、GPT-6 Astra 为 high，且为 OpenAI 所报）：Terminal-Bench 4.0 66.4% / 55.8% / 52.3% / 57.9% / 37.3%；FrontierCode v1.1 (Main) 54.4% / 50.3% / 48.0% / 53.3% / 47.5%。同表另有 Astra 更高的行：Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 为 64.6% 对 Opus 5.5 的 58.7%；AutomationBench（页注由 Zapier 跑）为 41.4% 对 40.0%。页面自己也写：与 Fable 5.1 的实际差距比这些分数看起来更窄。本库未复跑。

highlights.text: 作者称：非自回归、基于双向编码器的 System 1 决策模型，单次前向对任意状态（文本、邮件、工单、JSON）输出结构化决策与校准概率，不生成文本。
highlights.textEn: Author claim: a non-autoregressive System 1 decision model built on bidirectional encoders; one forward pass over any state (text, email, ticket, JSON) returns structured decisions with calibrated probabilities — no text generation.

highlights.text: 作者称：三类原语 — choice（从候选字典选一项，返回选项、分布与置信度）、score（按序数评分表定级）、noul（布尔问题，返回校准的 P(true)）。
highlights.textEn: Author claim: three primitives — choice (pick one key from a criteria dictionary, with distribution and confidence), score (place the state on an ordinal rubric), and noul (a boolean question returning calibrated P(true)).
